button.label: Insert Interlinear
button.supertip: Copy an interlinear selection in FLEx and click here, or paste the text into the document, select it, and click here. The example is drawn as a borderless table, one column per alignment slot, wrapped to the page.

button.label: Convert Table
button.screentip: Convert a plain table into an interlinear example
button.supertip: Turns an ordinary Word table -- typed by hand or pasted from a spreadsheet -- into an auto-wrapping interlinear example. One row per tier.

button.label: Text to Interlinear
button.screentip: Turn selected lines of text into an interlinear example
button.supertip: Select the lines: the words of the sentence on one line, their glosses on the next, the translation under them. Blank lines are ignored and a leading number such as (1) is dropped. You are asked how many of the last lines are translations. Aligned by word or by morpheme as the document is set.

button.label: Re-wrap All
button.screentip: Re-wrap every example in the document
button.supertip: Also runs automatically when the document is saved; the Re-wrap on Save toggle turns that off.

button.label: Re-wrap This
button.screentip: Re-wrap the example at the cursor
button.supertip: Recomputes the wrap from scratch, so columns move down when space runs out and back up when it is freed -- after a margin, font or orientation change, or an edit. A space typed into an interlinear cell becomes the document's replacement character (. or _).

button.label: Indent
button.screentip: Move the example half an inch to the right
button.supertip: The number and the translation move with it, and the example is re-wrapped to the narrower line. The indent is the table's own left indent, so the ruler works too.

button.label: Outdent
button.screentip: Move the example half an inch to the left

button.label: Split Column
button.screentip: Split the column at the cursor
button.supertip: Pulls an affix, clitic or reduplicant out into an alignment column of its own, carrying the morpheme break character onto the start of the new column on every interlinear tier. Use it to morpheme-align part of an otherwise word-aligned example.

button.label: Merge Columns
button.supertip: Select across several cells to merge exactly those. With the cursor in a single cell, that column is merged with the one after it.

toggleButton.label: By Word
toggleButton.screentip: New examples: one column per word
toggleButton.supertip: Enclitics stay in their host's column. Stored in this document; examples already on the page are unchanged until inserted again.

toggleButton.label: By Morpheme
toggleButton.screentip: New examples: one column per morpheme
toggleButton.supertip: Enclitic columns never start a wrap line. Stored in this document; examples already on the page are unchanged until inserted again.

toggleButton.label: Re-wrap on Save
toggleButton.screentip: Re-wrap every example when this document is saved

toggleButton.label: Re-wrap on Leave
toggleButton.screentip: Re-wrap an example as soon as the cursor leaves it
toggleButton.supertip: On by default. It fires only when the cursor leaves an example, never while you type inside one, and the cursor stays where you clicked.

toggleButton.label: Numbers
toggleButton.screentip: Number new examples (1), (2)... with Word list numbering
toggleButton.supertip: The number sits in a first column, continuing through the document, so deleting or moving an example renumbers the rest. To restart per chapter, link level 1 of the LingTeX Example Number list style to Heading 1 and set the list level to 2 in Settings.

toggleButton.label: First Capital
toggleButton.screentip: Grammatical glosses as Erg / 3Sg; off, uniform small capitals

button.label: Settings
button.supertip: How new examples are aligned and numbered, small capitals, the re-wrap triggers, every spacing at every level and in every direction, and the LingTeX styles, each of which opens in Word's own style dialog. Stored in this document.

button.label: Reset Styles
button.screentip: Make the LingTeX styles follow this document's Normal style again, and re-wrap
button.supertip: Replaces any size or font you set on a LingTeX style yourself. Asks first.

button.label: Install Shortcuts
button.screentip: Bind every command to Ctrl+Alt+Shift (Cmd+Option+Shift on Mac) + a letter
button.supertip: Installed in the Normal template, so they work in every document. LingTeXRemoveShortcuts takes them out again.

button.label: Check Glossing
button.screentip: Check the example against the glossing conventions
button.supertip: Reports columns whose cells disagree about a morpheme break character, spaces inside interlinear cells, form and gloss showing a different number of morpheme breaks, and unmatched infix brackets. Offers to fix the ones that have a single right answer. Grammatical glosses are recognised by their shape, so your own abbreviations are never flagged as unknown.
